scope: Bounded inventory: indexed training-related roots and fixed training subdirectories, explicit current LTX/ablation directories, saved evaluated adapters, and five reference methods model manifest. Not an exhaustive scan of every project or temporary smoke checkpoint. Historical ten-way evaluation protocol checkpoint parents and early component-ablation no_event directory are also included.
inspection: Path/stat, small trainer_state/receipt metadata only. No GPU, no new training, no large checkpoint rehash or full deserialization.
